name: background-gradient-animation
title: Background Gradient Animation
description: A full-screen animated backdrop of blurred coloured light blobs rotating over a purple-to-indigo gradient. The centre swells into a warm orb that shifts between yellow and pink, and a sixth glow follows the pointer.
use: A hero or full-page backdrop that needs a soft living gradient with no content of its own.
avoid: Nested layouts: it fills the viewport and writes CSS variables onto the whole body.
a11y: Purely decorative divs that animate forever with no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A full purple-to-indigo gradient field with a huge soft glowing orb in the middle that fades from warm yellow through pink. Everything is heavily blurred, and a faint blue light patch trails the cursor across the field.
behaves: Five coloured blobs drift and rotate continuously over the purple base, so the central glow swells and changes hue without ever settling. Moving the pointer drags a sixth coloured patch along with it.
customise: Every colour, the gradient ends, blob size, blending mode and the pointer toggle are props; the five animation keyframes live in the theme CSS.
weight: moderate: Six blurred full-size blobs composited with blend modes plus a pointer glow.
